instruction: Add blockchain-based digital signatures to this document using Writer's built-in blockchain verification system to ensure document authenticity.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because LibreOffice Writer does not have blockchain-based digital signature capabilities or a built-in blockchain verification system. While Writer supports traditional digital signatures using certificates, it does not offer blockchain-based document verification technology.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - LibreOffice Writer does not have blockchain-based digital signature capabilities
The 'infeasible' evaluator function is the appropriate choice for tasks that cannot be completed due to technical impossibility
Metadata correctly explains why the task is infeasible (non-existent feature in the software)
No verification logic is needed or possible for a task that cannot be completed
